rfqRoute: A buyer searching for business box packaging usually needs a practical brand packaging route, not a generic box catalog.
The RFQ should define product category, retail or e-commerce channel, box type, size, quantity range, material direction, printing area, finish preference, insert need and artwork status.
Business boxes can cover gift sets, product launches, subscription packs, sample kits and retail packaging, so the review should start from use case and product fit.
MUGE PACKAGING should route these searches to a quote checklist before asking buyers to compare price, so the factory review starts from structure, usage and brand presentation.
After publishing, this segment should be checked against Ads search terms, GA4 key events and GSC query/page movement before any bid or landing page decision.
